captions.caption: A man in camouflage pants and a green jacket kneels by a campfire in the woods.
He opens a plastic container, revealing strips of raw bacon inside.
He takes a single white egg out of the container with the bacon.
He holds the egg in his hand while looking at the container of bacon.
The man explains he has one egg and six pieces of bacon for his meal.
He talks about making a nice breakfast over the campfire.
He sets down the bacon and egg to prepare his cooking equipment.
He picks up a small metal pot and its lid from his gear.
A German Shepherd dog appears in the frame, watching the man prepare food.
The man holds the small metal pot and looks at his dog.
He speaks to his dog, telling it the food is not for him.
The dog continues to watch intently as the man prepares to crack the egg.
The man tells his dog he might give him a piece of bacon.
He cracks the egg on the side of the small metal pot.
He opens the egg, letting the yolk and white fall into the pot.
With the egg in the pot, he discards the shells to the side.
The man gestures toward his campfire in the background.
He reaches for a green water bottle sitting on the ground.
He brings the water bottle over to his cooking setup.
He unscrews the cap of the green water bottle.
He picks up a larger metal camping cup.
He blows debris off the cap of the water bottle before pouring.
He begins to pour water from the green bottle into the large metal cup.
He continues pouring water into the cup.
He stops pouring water and begins to screw the cap back on the bottle.
He finishes tightening the cap on the water bottle.
He sets the green water bottle down and picks up the pot with the egg.
He pours the raw egg into the larger cup that contains the water.
He sets down the now-empty small pot.
He picks up the lid for the large cup.
He places the lid on the cup containing the egg and water mixture.
He stands up from his kneeling position, holding the covered cup.
He walks over to the campfire grill.
He places the metal cup directly on the grill over the open fire.
The cup is now sitting on the fire to cook.
The man stands and watches the cup heat up on the fire.
He explains that he is cooking the egg first.
He states that his bacon won't take long to cook.
He kneels down and puts the lid back on the plastic container of bacon.
The scene begins to transition to a later time, indicated by a dimming effect.
A high-angle shot shows the fire pit with glowing embers and the cooking pot off to the side.
The man is now kneeling by the fire again, ready to cook the bacon.
He takes a strip of raw bacon out of the container.
He carefully places the strip of bacon onto the hot grill over the embers.
Smoke rises as the bacon begins to cook on the grill.
He reaches into the container to get another piece of bacon.
He holds the second strip of bacon over the grill.
He places the second strip of bacon on the grill next to the first one.
Two strips of bacon are now sizzling on the grill over the campfire embers.
The man watches the bacon cook on the fire.
A high-angle view shows the grill with two strips of bacon cooking over the embers.
The man kneels by the fire, with his cooking pot and bacon container nearby.
He picks up a third strip of bacon from the plastic container.
He places the third strip of bacon onto the grill.
He reaches for a fourth strip of bacon.
He adds the fourth strip of bacon to the cooking grill.
He picks up a fifth strip of bacon.
He places the fifth strip of bacon on the grill.
He grabs the last, sixth strip of bacon from the container.
He places the final strip of bacon on the grill, which is now full.
